page.layout: Printed page with one heading at top centre. Below it, two columns of index entries, left column then right column. No margin notes. Signature at the foot left, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.head: INDEX.

page.notes: The page number is not printed; only the signature G 3 and the catchword Cafi- appear at the foot. Uncertain readings: "Cafan" (the printed word looks like Calan or Cafan; alphabetical order suggests Cafan); the numbers after "Carolus IV Imperator" (84. 55) are hard to read. The entries "Carolus IIX" and "Carolus I rex Angliae" are copied as printed. The faint mirrored text in the background is show-through and was left out.
